### Welcome! 
  * At our school, we prepare students for life by combining academic knowledge, social-emotional learning, sports, and creative activities. We believe in the potential of every child and nurture it through modern, inspiring teaching, a differentiated approach, and a supportive environment.
  *   

  * For us, school is not just a place for acquiring knowledge. We shape individuals. At Deni Diderot School, children grow up curious, thoughtful, confident, and responsible—ready to face the challenges of the future.


[Learn more](https://denisdiderot.bg/about-us/our-identity)
  * Educational and intellectual advancement
  * Social-emotional skills and teamwork
  * Healthy and eco-friendly way of living
  * Shared values and a strong sense of community

### Environmental protection
is part of the vision of the Denis Diderot School. The environment in which the children grow up in is critical for their education as sustainability-oriented, environmentally-conscious people. The 6,000 m2 campus is located in the town of Bankya in an ecologically pristine region. Only natural materials were used in the construction of the school, and an ozonation system reduces the carbon emissions. The irrigation system works with collected rainwater; in the dry season, water is drilled from the ground.

# Admission 
Choosing a school is a significant step for a child’s future. It’s important for this decision to be conscious, transparent, and mutual.
## **Open enrollment for 2027/2028 for preschool (children born in 2021), 1st and 5th grade!**
How does the application process work?
**1. Open House Days**
We organize several throughout the school year, during school hours so families can experience the authentic atmosphere of school life. Open House Days include a presentation, a tour, and meetings with teachers. Parents are welcome to attend together with their children. For our prospective students, we have prepared a themed activity and a tour of the school, during which they will have the opportunity to get acquainted with the atmosphere, the team and the learning environment in an engaging and age-appropriate way. Please, if you would like to attend, fill the [_**form**_](https://denisdiderot.bg/en-us/admission#open-doors). 
Even if you’ve missed the announced dates or don’t see any currently listed on our website, you can request an individual visit on a school day by filling out an [_**online form**_](https://system.denisdiderot.bg/admission/application).
  

###### ![image](https://denisdiderot.bg/Portals/0/Images/Infographica_Sait_Priem_Big_Size_EN_FINAL.jpg)
**2. Submitting an Application**
Parents fill out an [_**online form**_](https://system.denisdiderot.bg/admission/application) to register in the application system. A staff member will contact them to schedule a convenient time for a meeting.
**3. Individual Meeting with the Director**
We discuss the family’s expectations and views to determine whether we share common attitudes and understandings about the child’s education and upbringing. 
**4. One-Day School Visit for the Child**
This visit allows the child to actively participate in the activities included in the program. It provides valuable insight for both the parents and the child into what they can expect at our school. 
**5. Feedback and Final Decision by Both Parties**
After the visit, feedback is shared in a meeting or via email, reflecting the observations of both the school and the family.
**6. Signing the Contract**
Our goal is for every child to feel they belong, and for every family to feel confident that they’ve made the right choice.

# Прием
Изборът на училище е значима за бъдещето на детето стъпка. Важно е той да бъде осъзнат, открит и двустранен.
## **Отворен прием 2027/2028 за ПГ, родени през 2021 г., 1. и 5. клас!**
Как протича процесът на кандидатстване?
###### **1. Дни на отворени врати**
Организираме ги няколко пъти в рамките на учебната годината. В учебно време, за да може семействата да усетят училищния живот в неговата автентичност. Дните на отворените врати включват презентация, разходка и запознаване с учители. За бъдещите ни ученици сме подготвили тематично занимание и разходка, по време на които те ще могат да се запознаят с атмосферата, екипа и средата по един интересен и подходящ за възрастта им начин. Моля задължително попълнете [_**формата**_](https://denisdiderot.bg/bg-bg/%D0%BF%D1%80%D0%B8%D0%B5%D0%BC#open-doors). 
Дори да сте пропуснали датите за отворените врати, можете да заявите индивидуално посещение в учебен ден като попълните следния [**_онлайн формуляр_**](https://system.denisdiderot.bg/admission/application).
######   

[ ](https://system.denisdiderot.bg/admission/application)![image](https://denisdiderot.bg/Portals/0/Images/Infographica_Sait_Priem_Big_Size_FINAL.jpg)
###### **2. Подаване на заявление**
Родителите попълват [**_онлайн формуляр_**](https://system.denisdiderot.bg/admission/application), с който се регистрират в системата за кандидатстване. С тях ще се свърже служител, за да се определи удобен момент за среща.
###### **3. Индивидуална среща с директор**
Обсъждаме очакванията и вижданията на семейството, за да преценим дали споделяме общи нагласи и разбирания за обучението и възпитанието на детето. 
###### **4. Еднодневно гостуване на детето**
Гостуването в училище е важна стъпка, която позволява на детето да участва активно в дейностите, които са включени в програмата. Това преживяване носи информация и на родителите, и на детето, какво могат да очакват в нашето училище. По време на гостуването детето е пълноценна част от класа, преминава през тест за ниво на знанията, които са очаквани за съответната възрастова група. Запознава се със средата, учителите и децата. 
  * При кандидатстване за 1. клас се провежда тест за училищна готовност. 
  * При кандидатстване за 5. клас се провеждат тестове по различни предметни области.


###### **5. Обратна връзка и финално решение на двете страни**
След гостуването се споделя обратна връзка в среща или имейл за наблюденията и на двете страни - училището и семейството.
###### **6. Подписване на договор**
Нашата цел е всяко дете да се чувства на мястото си, а всяко семейство – уверено, че е направило правилния избор.

Dear parents,
Children’s safety is our shared and most important priority during travel. Therefore, it is particularly
important that you familiarise children with these rules – with their purpose and significance.
School Transport Team of Denis Diderot Private Secondary School
Rules for Enrolment for and Organisation of School Transport at
Denis Diderot Private Secondary School
Rules for Safety During Travel
1. The driver must have all necessary documents and certificates and must comply with all
laws, standards and regulations of Bulgaria and the European Union for driving and
transportation.
2. Every morning, all bus drivers must undergo a medical check-up (alcohol, drugs, general
health) in accordance with Ordinance No. 33.
3. Listening to music, consuming food and beverages, smoking (including e-cigarettes), using
foul language or acting improperly by the drivers while driving shall not be allowed.
4. Drivers may not use mobile phones while driving, unless using a handsfree equipment.
5. Students must occupy their designated seats on the bus and must wear seatbelts.
6. Students must be calm and must keep quiet. Noisy behaviour, pushing, throwing objects,
unfastening seatbelts and changing seats without permission shall not be allowed.
7. Consumption of food and beverages (except water) is prohibited.
8. It is prohibited to ask the driver questions, as well as to walk around the bus during travel.
9. It is important to maintain cleanliness and to protect the bus and the equipment thereof.
10. The instructions of the bus driver must be followed.
11. Students must not get off the bus until it has stopped completely and the driver has given
them permission to do so.
Enrolment
1. When enrolling a student in the school, the parents must indicate whether they want to use
school transport and if yes, from which bus stop exactly.
2. Schedules, routes and bus stops shall be published on the school website, School
Transport Section.
3. Signing a contract for the use of school transport shall be carried out no later than 15 July
of the respective year and such contact shall be renewed annually.
4. After this date, new applications shall be accepted only if there are free seats on the buses.
5. Requests to change a requested bus stop or route after the specified deadline shall be
viewed on an exceptional basis and may be allowed only if they do not violate or change
the existing routes and travel organisation.
6. When there are not enough seats available, seat distribution shall be in accordance with
the order of submission of the applications and the signing of the contracts. The school
shall be entitled to limit additional admission and refuse transport after the bus capacity is
filled, or to provide alternative transport.
Travel Principles
1. The buses shall travel on the approved route and schedule. Only the approved bus stops
along the route shall be used for passengers getting on and off the bus.
2. Buses shall wait no more than 1 minute at a bus stop for late passengers. Those who have
missed the bus at a given bus stop can go to the next bus stop (if there is one). Buses do
not stop at places other than the designated bus stops.
3. All buses shall be equipped with CCTV cameras and access control systems.
4. At the start of the school year, each child shall receive a personal ID chip, card or watch
that must be used to check in and out every time they get on and off the bus. This is
important for the children’s safety.
5. When getting off the bus, the children shall be handed over to a parent or an authorized
representative thereof. If a child is not met by a parent/authorized representative at the bus
stop, they shall remain on the bus and continue along the designated route. If, by the end
of the route, the child has still not been met by a parent/person in charge, the child shall be
left in the special waiting room in the Head Office of ProCredit Bank at 26 Todor
Aleksandrov Blvd.
General
1. In case of complaints and incidents – recordings shall be checked, parents shall be notified
and measures shall be taken.
2. The school shall be entitled to suspend the use of transport by students who systematically
violate the established rules and endanger the safety of the other passengers with their
behaviour. This shall take place as follows:
- In the event of 3 remarks within 1 calendar month from an adult observer, an e-mail to the
parent shall be sent.
- In the event of a subsequent violation, the right to use transport shall be suspended for
1 week.
- In the event of 5 remarks within 1 calendar month, the right to use transport shall be
terminated with a one month’s notice.
